cards.concept: CTE as a named relational stage
cards.intuition: Give a meaningful intermediate result a name so its grain and transformation are visible within one statement.
cards.formula: WITH stage AS (query) SELECT ... FROM stage
cards.topic: Common Table Expressions for Readable Query Pipelines

cards.concept: CTE physical behavior is not guaranteed
cards.intuition: The optimizer may substitute the CTE logic or store its intermediate output. Syntax improves structure, not promised speed.
cards.formula: CTE may be inlined or materialized; inspect the plan
cards.topic: Common Table Expressions for Readable Query Pipelines

cards.intuition: Use a temporary or persisted table when expensive output must be computed once, reused across statements, indexed, or audited.
cards.formula: reuse across statements or required checkpoint → explicit table
cards.topic: Common Table Expressions for Readable Query Pipelines

cards.intuition: An uncorrelated query stands alone. A correlated query borrows the current outer row, so its logical input changes as the outer row changes.
cards.formula: correlated subquery references an outer-query column

cards.intuition: A few indexed probes can be excellent; millions of repeated scans can be catastrophic. Check outer cardinality, indexes, and decorrelation in the plan.
cards.formula: risk ≈ outer rows × inner work per row

cards.intuition: When many outer rows need the same grouped inner facts, scan and group the inner table once, then join its one-row-per-key result.
cards.formula: inner GROUP BY key → join outer on key

cards.intuition: UNION ALL stacks rows exactly as supplied. UNION additionally builds set semantics by removing duplicate complete tuples.
cards.formula: UNION ALL = concatenate; UNION = concatenate + DISTINCT
cards.topic: UNION vs UNION ALL and Duplicate Semantics

cards.intuition: Deduplication requires hashing or sorting combined rows, potentially spilling and shuffling. Do not pay it when sources are provably disjoint.
cards.formula: UNION dedup state scales with combined rows and distinct tuples
cards.topic: UNION vs UNION ALL and Duplicate Semantics

cards.intuition: UNION sees every selected column. Rows with one key but different timestamps or scores need an explicit precedence policy.
cards.formula: UNION ALL → ROW_NUMBER by business key and source priority → keep 1
cards.topic: UNION vs UNION ALL and Duplicate Semantics

cards.intuition: Aliases do not rescue swapped columns. Select the same explicit columns in the same order and cast types intentionally.
cards.formula: branch column i aligns with branch column i
cards.topic: UNION vs UNION ALL and Duplicate Semantics
